_comment: EDIT THIS FILE, NOT THE CODE. Everything the scorer knows about the candidate lives here. Be honest in 'lacks' - that is what stops false positives.
summary: One paragraph: field, years, the two or three things you are actually known for.
has: Concrete capability, named the way a posting would name it
Tools and platforms you have operated, not just seen
Domain exposure that lets you read a posting in that field
lacks: Systems you have never built or run
Adjacent-sounding experience you do NOT have - the near-misses matter most
targets: Role families worth an alert, in the words postings use
geography: Where you will work, and whether you will relocate.
notes_for_scorer: Judge by requirements, not title. CRITICAL: distinguish REQUIRED from PREFERRED. A posting stating it requires something listed in lacks is a NO. The same thing marked preferred, a plus, or nice to have is at worst a STRETCH. Degree language works the same way: a required degree is a hard gate, or relevant experience in lieu of degree is not.
education: State the highest completed credential, and whether a required degree should gate or only downgrade to STRETCH.
